connector.name: Cortex402
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-call x402 data products on Base mainnet - sanctions, aviation weather, US property.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cortex402-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ooak21 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: CORTEX402_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key (hex, 0x-prefixed) for an EVM wallet on Base mainnet holding USDC. Used to sign EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for each call. Easiest funding: Coinbase Wallet → Buy → USDC on Base network → debit card (~$5 covers ~50 calls).

env.name: CORTEX402_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://cortex402.vercel.app — only set this for staging or local development.

env.name: CORTEX402_MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
env.description: Per-call payment ceiling in USDC. Defaults to 5.00 (covers sanctions $0.50, aviation $0.10, property $2.00 with headroom). Raise if calling other x402 endpoints through this server.
